capabilities.summary: Platform-neutral recorder core: start/stop/status lifecycle with partial-bundle quarantine and stale-session recovery, immutable hashed session bundles (record-session v1 manifest, record-event v1 telemetry), per-field redaction before persistence, bundle verification, and the step-to-frame reader. OS capture is delegated to helpers behind the Backend trait.
policyNotes: Declaration-only: the lifecycle, bundle writer, redaction and reader are not an ownership fingerprint.
No OS capture lives in this crate; the macOS and Windows helpers implement the Backend trait in later slices.
